## 2. Core Engineering Philosophy
- **Anti-Fragile Architecture**: Building systems that do not break under unexpected network dropouts or state shifts (offline-first sync with SQLite, resilient error boundaries).
- **Clean Code & Modularity**: Separation of concerns using Clean Architecture patterns, strict typing with TypeScript, and reusable component hierarchies.
- **Expressive Aesthetic (Neo-Brutalism)**: Utilizing high-contrast typography, functional drop shadows, deliberate borders, and engaging micro-interactions that communicate confidence and clarity.

## 3. Detailed Project Case Studies

### Project 01: InformationPerisai-System (UMI Research Portal)
- **Category**: Web Application
- **Role**: Full-Stack Software Engineer
- **Challenge / Problem**: UKM PERISAI UMI had fragmented research documentation scattered across messaging groups and physical paper archives, resulting in frequent data loss and tedious manual search.
- **Solution & Process**: Designed and built an encrypted digital archive and publication repository using Next.js App Router, TypeScript, and Turso cloud database. Implemented role-based access control, fast full-text search, and automated audit logs.
- **Tools**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Turso DB, Git.
- **Result**: Reduced document retrieval latency from 25 minutes to under 2 seconds; zero document loss reported across 4 active academic departments.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy

### Project 02: Mandiri Global — Fashion Sale System
- **Category**: Web Application
- **Role**: Fullstack Web Developer
- **Challenge / Problem**: Retail fashion brand Mandiri Global required a dedicated digital storefront with precise variant-level stock management (sizes & colors), automated 15-minute order reservations to prevent dead stock, and seamless payment gateway validation without manual order confirmations.
- **Solution & Process**: Architected a production fullstack application with Next.js App Router and TypeScript, using PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM. Integrated Midtrans Snap payment gateway with automated server-side webhook validation, Biteship shipping calculation, and atomic stock reservation.
- **Tools**: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma ORM, PostgreSQL, Midtrans API, Biteship.
- **Result**: Deployed live production e-commerce store with zero inventory overselling, automated payment reconciliation, and streamlined order fulfillment.
- **Live URL**: https://fashion-sale-system.vercel.app/
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy/fashionSale-System

### Project 03: Promptverse AI Studio
- **Category**: Web Application
- **Role**: Software Engineer
- **Challenge / Problem**: Engineers and prompt designers waste time repeatedly formatting, storing, and testing complex system prompts across multiple LLM playgrounds without version history.
- **Solution & Process**: Developed a developer-centric workbench to organize, test, and benchmark prompt templates with real-time token cost estimation and dynamic parameter substitution.
- **Tools**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, OpenAI API.
- **Result**: Streamlined prompt engineering workflow with instant JSON/YAML export.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy

### Project 04: AgroScan Leaf Doctor
- **Category**: Mobile Application (Android)
- **Role**: Mobile Software Engineer
- **Challenge / Problem**: Farmers in rural areas often lack immediate access to agricultural experts, and internet connectivity is frequently unavailable on farmlands.
- **Solution & Process**: Built a Flutter Android app capable of capturing leaf photos and executing on-device machine learning inference offline to detect common plant diseases and recommend treatment steps.
- **Tools**: Flutter, Dart, Android, SQLite, On-device ML Pipeline.
- **Result**: Enabled offline disease diagnosis within 450ms on low-to-mid range Android devices.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy

### Project 05: Scania Fleet Navigator
- **Category**: Mobile Application (Android)
- **Role**: Mobile & Systems Engineer
- **Challenge / Problem**: Inter-city transport operators frequently experience GPS dead-zones, leading to lost location telemetry and inaccurate arrival estimates.
- **Solution & Process**: Created a driver-facing mobile navigation dashboard with background location tracking, localized vector tile caching, and automatic sync upon reconnection.
- **Tools**: Flutter, Dart, Android, SQLite, Leaflet.js.
- **Result**: Guaranteed 100% route recovery after cellular reconnects with zero memory leaks over 12-hour continuous driving shifts.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy

### Project 06: HabitForge Minimalist
- **Category**: Mobile Application (Android)
- **Role**: Mobile Application Developer
- **Challenge / Problem**: Most habit apps overwhelm users with ads, complex social feeds, and mandatory account creation.
- **Solution & Process**: Crafted an offline-first micro-habit tracker with brutalist visual feedback, GitHub-style consistency heatmaps, and zero telemetry overhead.
- **Tools**: Flutter, Dart, Android, SQLite.
- **Result**: Instant launch time (<150ms) with full user privacy and local data ownership.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy

### Project 07: Manga Travel Booking Engine
- **Category**: Multi-Platform System
- **Role**: Backend Developer (KKP Internship)
- **Challenge / Problem**: Travel agency suffered from double-booking risks and slow manual phone reservations during peak holiday seasons.
- **Solution & Process**: Developed an automated web reservation engine in Laravel and MySQL with dynamic seat layout visualization, automated WhatsApp notifications, and payment invoice tracking.
- **Tools**: Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Bootstrap, RESTful API.
- **Result**: Processed reservations with zero double-booking concurrency bugs; reduced booking confirmation time by 80%.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy

### Project 08: SmartGate RFID Parking System
- **Category**: Multi-Platform System
- **Role**: Software & Systems Integrator
- **Challenge / Problem**: Campus/facility gate congestion due to slow manual validation tickets.
- **Solution & Process**: Integrated serial RFID readers with a Java desktop control server and centralized MySQL database to automate barrier lifting, vehicle logging, and blacklist alerts.
- **Tools**: Java, MySQL, Linux Shell, Hardware Serial Interface.
- **Result**: Reduced average gate passage time from 15 seconds to under 1.5 seconds per vehicle.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy

### Project 09: WeatherPulse Hyperlocal
- **Category**: Web Application
- **Role**: Frontend Developer
- **Challenge / Problem**: Heavy, ad-ridden weather websites consume excessive mobile data and deliver confusing meteorological charts.
- **Solution & Process**: Designed a lightweight, high-contrast dashboard featuring animated precipitation vectors, interactive wind speed gauges, and hourly weather radar tiles.
- **Tools**: TypeScript, React, Tailwind CSS, OpenWeather API.
- **Result**: Delivered real-time hyperlocal forecasts in a package under 50KB gzipped.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/Justrifkyy
